record.selected_question: Can independently established direct-rounding-cell membership and current strictly increasing actual stored clocks discharge the existing final authored-ordering proof with positive net charged savings on a precisely admitted native invocation?

premises: Every source authored clock a_i is its current exact nonnegative canonical rational.
Every stored word b_i is the actual finite nonnegative binary32 value used by the same current clock axis.
Each a_i belongs to the independently established direct round-to-nearest, ties-to-even cell for b_i.
mathematical_review.proof: For ordered distinct finite binary32 values, direct rounding cells are ordered and disjoint. Adjacent cells may share a numerical midpoint, but ties-to-even assigns that midpoint to exactly one cell; nonadjacent cells have a gap. Therefore a_i in the earlier cell and a_(i+1) in the later cell imply a_i < a_(i+1). Canonical positive zero and the finite maximum's conceptual overflow neighbor preserve this ordering.
mathematical_review.preservation: This is an alternative proof of the same independent authored-ordering condition. It does not authorize trusting producer labels or dropping the ordering requirement.
